In this intriguing video, we dive into the world of "The Kerala Story," a recently released film that has caught the attention of movie buffs and political watchers alike.What is the real story behind the movie? Are the claims made in the movie legit? And more. We explore the movie's interesting storyline and the controversies it has stirred up. Discover how "The Kerala Story" connects to the ever-changing political landscape, shedding light on real-life situations. From its influence on public discussions to the heated debates it has sparked, we examine the film's impact on both politics and the country. Join us as we unravel the fascinating relationship between "The Kerala Story" and the political world that surrounds it.

About the Channel:
Nitish Rajput firmly believes that there are adequate tools available online, and people can be brought together, informed, and educated collectively. 
Social media and the Internet have the power to create any narrative but this channel will use the same to curate a healthy, informative narrative that can genuinely benefit people in forming an opinion that is backed by facts and uncompromised information without any bias. Nitish Rajput wants to empower and facilitate people to challenge atrocities and become more vocal about issues plaguing Indian society.
